phaseScoreMethod: Each Stage 2 implementation phase 21-39 has equal source weight. A score requires integrated production callers; isolated tested modules receive scaffold or runtime-blocked credit only. The rounded arithmetic mean is Stage 2 source readiness.

phaseScores.name: Canonical model-to-tool control plane
phaseScores.gap: Existing governed runs are not one canonical Brain/Director/Hands/Eyes/Verifier contract with typed model-output decoding and fail-closed verification. This entry previously cited src/lib/work/orchestrator.ts, which has never existed in this repository; the citation is corrected to the modules that actually carry the tool control plane, and the absence of a single canonical orchestrator is precisely the gap recorded above.

phaseScores.name: Multi-provider local model fabric
phaseScores.gap: LM Studio, llama.cpp, LocalAI, vLLM, Jan, KoboldCpp, generic discovery, circuit breakers and tested failover are missing.

phaseScores.name: Secure generated-code sandbox
phaseScores.gap: There is no ephemeral generated-code runner with process, filesystem, network, resource, termination and cleanup isolation.

phaseScores.name: Windows companion and permission setup
phaseScores.gap: UI Automation, permission setup assistance and real Windows action proof remain; full Tauri linking is blocked by missing MSVC link.exe.

phaseScores.name: Perception, Set-of-Mark and state fingerprints
phaseScores.gap: No fused UIA/OCR/icon/vision perception, numbered targets, protected-region masks or multi-monitor scaling implementation exists.

phaseScores.name: Universal route selector
phaseScores.gap: Existing method selection is not the complete API/plugin/CLI/file/DOM/accessibility/native/vision/input route hierarchy.

phaseScores.name: Unknown-App Learning and Digital Twins
phaseScores.gap: The learned map path lacks a real probe host, rehearsal integration, versioned skill compilation and unfamiliar-application runtime proof.

phaseScores.name: Chrome and Edge control
phaseScores.gap: The extension is built, loads into real Chromium, and 35 scenarios pass against it: tab control, DOM read, click, type, scroll, observe-act-observe verification, pause/stop/take-over latches surviving a service-worker restart, protected-field hand-over, and the website channel being unable to widen its own scope. Remaining: selector healing, controlled web-lab execution, and the same evidence against Edge and against a store-installed Chrome rather than one loaded unpacked. The score is left at 65 deliberately: it feeds the published readiness mean, and re-deriving that model is an owner decision rather than a side effect of this repair.

phaseScores.name: Email and web work
phaseScores.gap: Connector-first email, draft/recipient/attachment validation and safe web-editor workflows are missing.

phaseScores.name: Creative application control
phaseScores.gap: Blender and creative-application adapters, checkpoints, render execution and export verification are missing.

phaseScores.name: CAD and engineering application control
phaseScores.gap: No generic CAD/CAE route, units/constraint guard, duplicate-project workflow, solver boundary or verified export path exists.

phaseScores.name: Resource Governor
phaseScores.gap: Generic estimation is not wired to live hardware discovery, model/renderer/solver selection or reversible OS performance profiles.

phaseScores.name: Mobile mission control
phaseScores.gap: The OcadeMobile native plugin, signed live transport and complete task correction/pause/resume/output runtime are missing.

phaseScores.name: Relay and reconnect protocol
phaseScores.gap: LAN/local/managed relay implementations, acknowledgements, revocation and reconnect reconciliation are missing.

phaseScores.name: Voice and multimodal connectors
phaseScores.gap: Provider contracts, recorded-audio fixtures, local/licensed voices and headless multimodal connectors are incomplete.

phaseScores.name: Packaging and coding-only release preparation
phaseScores.gap: Windows beta installer proof, CI, dev signing, hosting scripts, update activation and clean-machine rollback evidence remain.

phaseScores.name: Universal application coverage run
phaseScores.gap: No approved installed application has a versioned real-runtime coverage record.

phaseScores.name: Adversarial reliability and performance proof
phaseScores.gap: Stage 2 stale-state, escape, crash, reconnect, overnight and live-resource campaigns have not run.

phaseScores.name: Final universal-control audit
phaseScores.gap: The final Stage 2 audit cannot begin before Phases 21-38.

productionFormula: round(stage2Source*0.50 + windowsRuntime*0.15 + browserRuntime*0.10 + anyAppRuntime*0.10 + mobileRuntime*0.05 + applicationCoverage*0.05 + externallyValidatedPackaging*0.05)

firstIncompleteDependency.name: Canonical model-to-tool control plane
firstIncompleteDependency.reason: Every provider, sandbox, companion, perception, route, app, browser and mobile executor must consume one fail-closed typed plan and emit independently verified evidence.
